disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this is a
long but meaningful email that I hope you’ll read to the end.

Last week, democratic socialist Darializa Avila Chevalier defeated an
AIPAC and corporate-backed 5-term incumbent, Rep. Adriano Espaillat, in
the Democratic primary for New York’s 13th congressional district.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260630-2.m0vvnh&refcode=em20260630-37978&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37978%2E1203867%2Ek7z8NH ]Your support directly contributed to this momentous victory, and if
we’re going to win our final three primaries this summer, we need you with
us now. Can you rush a donation before tonight’s end-of-quarter
fundraising deadline?

Justice Democrats was proud to endorse Darializa from the first day she
launched her campaign back in November, but our story together didn’t
start there.

Darializa is a working-class, Afro-Latina, and UAW union member who has
been organizing in Upper Manhattan for a fairer, more equitable, and more
affordable New York City since she was a teenager. The daughter of
working-class, Dominican immigrant parents, she witnessed loved ones
struggle with immigration issues, socioeconomic inequality, and the
criminal justice system throughout her life.

Darializa saw firsthand how ICE has terrorized communities in New York and
across the country, and directly fought back. During Donald Trump’s first
term, she organized to help free U.S. permanent resident Abdikadir Mohamed
from his 1.5-year ICE detention caused by the 2017 ‘Muslim ban,’ reunited
separated immigrant families as an organizer at Families for Freedom, and
then became an investigator for the public defender’s office in Harlem
supporting New Yorkers on some of the hardest days of their lives.

Darializa’s organizing has also been defined by her commitment to
Palestinian freedom and an end to U.S. complicity in Israel’s genocide in
Gaza. As an undergraduate at Columbia University, Darializa participated
in a summer abroad program in the West Bank of Palestine, where she
learned Arabic and taught English to Palestinian children living in nearby
refugee camps.

She went on to organize for a free Palestine after returning to campus in
New York. From 2023-2024, Darializa worked alongside her friend Mahmoud
Khalil — who ICE famously kidnapped and detained — as one of the lead
organizers of the Columbia University encampment. She also organized with
a collective in NY-13 called Uptown for Palestine, which tried reaching
their representative, Adriano Espaillat, on this issue for over 15 months
to no avail.

Funded by AIPAC, Adriano was silent on Israel’s genocide and has never
missed a vote to fund Israel’s military. Then, when questioned about Trump
targeting Mahmoud for exercising his freedom of speech, the Congressman
didn’t fight for his constituent. Instead, he said that he “trusted”
Trump’s Department of Justice to “follow the law.”

It further confirmed that this incumbent was completely out of touch and
unwilling to fight for New Yorkers like Mahmoud — which meant he was
unwilling to fight for any of us.

After organizing this district to help democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani
win the New York mayoral race by double digits, Darializa believed the
time had come for New Yorkers to replace Adriano.

She actually emailed Justice Democrats in February 2025 looking to
strategize around finding someone to challenge her absent congressman!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260630-2.m0vvnh&refcode=em20260630-37978&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37978%2E1203867%2Ek7z8NH ]Screengrab of an email from Darializa Avila Chevalier to Justice
Democrats: "A few of us have been thinking that it might be worth
introducing an electoral strategy to unseat or push him on his policies.
Personally, my organizing experience is in grassroots/direct action work
and would love to talk with someone who would be willing to do some
strategy/power mapping with us on the feasibility of an electoral strategy
against an establishment Dem. Is this something you'd be interested in? If
so, is there a window of time where we could meet to discuss further? I
know it's a really hard and busy time for most of us, so I really
appreciate your time! Sincerely, Darializa Avila Chevalier"

But Darializa never saw herself as the candidate to take on Adriano. She
was a community organizer who wanted to support Justice Democrats to
connect with people on the ground to find the right challenger to their
do-nothing incumbent.

name: Dylan for Wisconsin
subject: Why I Got Into This Race
body:
I know that we can do better, and I will help us do better by bringing transparency and accountability to our financial systems.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fd736c67cf1b/c2y1sg9w12-10123135?e=f59034ca3e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/DK_bKQnDuk_?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| | | | | | Hi Peter,
In January of this year, my proposed resolution to backfill special education funding was approved by 93% of voting Wisconsin School Boards. That included rural and urban, red and blue, and districts of all sizes. Wisconsin is ready to work together to fix our school funding.

---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ZEMjiOq1l0G?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
| |
That is why I got into this race, and decided to run for State office. Everyone I talked to had the same complaints and the same concerns, and as I was in a position to listen, I also wanted to be in a position to help.
The broken promise of Special Education funding from the state is just one of many times that we have lost resources, dollars, and clarity from a system that is supposed to be benefiting us, not dragging us down. I know that we can do better, and I will help us do better by bringing transparency and accountability to our financial systems.

---
|
---
| | [**We are just hours away from an end-of-quarter deadline for fundraising. If there is any amount you can give, even just a few dollars, now is the time I need your help most. Please help get me through the primary in August so we can bring transparency and accountability back to Wisconsin.**](https://us.list-manage.com/rLgVeE8YtEt?e=f59034ca3e&c2id=997c4beee76ce03997da9db4fe50bd09)
Thank you...Dylan

body:
| | | Something exciting is happening, Peter. From New York City to California, New Mexico, Washington, D.C., and beyond, voters have been choosing candidates who unapologetically champion working people over billionaires and corporate interests. That winning streak isn't an accident — it's the result of thousands of volunteers having conversations with voters, one door at a time. Now it's Michigan's turn. I’m glad I caught you.

We're just hours from our first FEC deadline of the general election, and I know you've heard from us a lot these past few days. So before I say anything else, I want to say thank you — truly.

Campaigns move fast. There's always another deadline, another goal, another ask. And in the rush of it all, it would be easy to start treating the people who power this campaign like names on a fundraising list. I refuse to do that. Because you are not a number to me, and you are certainly not an ATM.

You are the entire reason this campaign exists.

When I look at what we've built — a campaign going toe to toe with corporate money and entrenched power, without taking a dime from corporate PACs — I don't see dollars. I see thousands of real people who chipped in what they could because they believe working families deserve a real fighter in Washington.

I want you to know this victory belongs to every single one of you. Tonight, Denver voters – of all ages, all races, all religions – sent a clear message: We will not wait.
| | | | | [](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001HwlqE664ppu8cLcv8U1s1S0mKbR2zhq07xx99HMe3tr81KjL_r3RakP1xoWgkN-YSuYwFVJMPfZZBW9_AZPj4F2FOvuMh1GpKzVXBSu9xyPV5EqSAFQNPiYzLOi9AqxNyER-cidmeHZm7z6NwzSms6A1SEWFXgGfIPnintTlmuxEC9K0HMi_5ihuM018h_BQ66G7jkgLfKynH4T57CFfXs5PDz4zSWypBVfP2kbulOpdjdoer1WLSqaEqeGWHx5ewyhiFMHJfR54a8yRr06oovN2X0Ov3Fo1p2P2DcVrsWI=&c=DiFvDSGUy1cTEceDOWCobK66YLmJ6adTU189JJiJOlqIuwq9K6bxvw==&ch=UlQhyR5QcGsgoPRcPCHMSbvkdYsx_pxoytyHzigLOcZjhZMVGMcx7Q==)
---
| I want you to know this victory belongs to every single one of you.
Tonight, Denver voters - of all ages, all races, all religions - sent a clear message: We will not wait.
We will not wait to bring the fight to Donald Trump and the oligarchy.
We will not wait to demand that Congress abolish ICE and pass Medicare for All.
We will not wait to end the politics of the past. To get big money out of our elections. To reject Corporate PACs and AIPAC.
And no, we will not wait to end the genocide in Gaza.
We believe that fundamental change can, and will, happen if we fight for it. If we organize. If we show no fear in standing up for what's right.
That is the message Denver has sent to the establishment of both parties. To Donald Trump. To the entire country.
A year ago, a lot of experienced people told us this was impossible. That you can't win without corporate PAC money. That you can't beat a 30-year incumbent. That the establishment and the oligarchy is just too big and too powerful to overcome.
But one year, 6,500 volunteers, 100,000 doors, and 500,000 calls later, you are proof that the power of organized people is greater than the power of organized money.
I want to thank you all, each and every one of the people in this room, for coming to support this campaign and this movement. To Justice Democrats, Denver DSA, the Working Families Party, to Sunrise, to our incredible organizing team, the greatest a girl could ever ask for, that has made history: Thank you for everything you have done to make tonight possible.
I also want to acknowledge Congresswoman Diana DeGette. I am grateful I am for her service to Denver and her fight for reproductive freedom. She helped build the community that welcomed my family to this district, and I'll always be grateful for that.
And I want to thank Senator Bernie Sanders for his support, and every single progressive running for office in Colorado and across the country for inspiration and solidarity.
I want to tell you something about why this campaign started. Because it matters for what comes next.
When I wrote a letter defending students' rights to protest the genocide in Gaza, my law firm told me: take it down or you're fired. I didn't flinch. Because I stood by every word. And I always will.
I know that will not be the only moment where those in power will tell me to change my tune, to not rock the boat. That seems to happen a lot in Congress. But here in Denver we stand by our values, we stand with our community.
In five days, this country turns 250 years old. I've been thinking a lot about what that means. Not the fireworks - the promise that this country belongs to everyone who loves what it stands for. Not just the people born here. Not just the people who look a certain way. Everyone who believes that democracy is worth defending and that every person deserves dignity.
I'm about the same age as my dad when he came to this country. Betting on that promise. He chose Denver as our home because he thought the city would welcome us. And that same city just voted to send a 29-year-old recovering lawyer, barista, immigrant, and democratic socialist to Congress.
The future is being written right now. Nothing is set in stone. Denver we won tonight, but this is about something so much bigger than one moment. This is a movement, and we are just getting started.
Thank you, all. I am honored to be your voice in DC. Let's go to work! In solidarity,
Melat Kiros

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
I'm a pediatrician. I’m pissed. I’m scared. And I need your help to defeat Lindsey Graham in the U.S. Senate.
I’m not the “monsters-under-the-bed” kind of scared. I’m the “I’ve watched children suffer from preventable illness and injury while politicians do absolutely nothing” kind of scared.
I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.
But I’m scared. I’m pissed. I’m motivated. And I’m 100% in.
I’m running for Senate in South Carolina to defeat Lindsey Graham and to fight for the kids no one in D.C. seems to be thinking about. So I need you with me.
We need to hit 10,000 donations before midnight to prove that this campaign can go the distance. Can I count on you to split a donation with my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
HELP ME DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
I’m running because the Republican Party, led by people like Lindsey Graham, is dismantling the very systems that keep our kids safe here in South Carolina.
I’m running because the issues I care about — children’s healthcare, vaccines, gun violence, public education, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare — are under direct attack right now.
And I’m running because I consider it my professional duty as a pediatrician — to give children a strong voice at the national level. Too many are comfortable on the sidelines. That won’t work for me.
We need bold leaders who aren’t afraid to fight. I am ready.
Even though the path will be hard, I know Lindsey Graham must be held accountable. He certainly doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.
That’s why I’m running for US Senate. To defeat Trump’s lapdog and fight for everyday Americans. But, I need your support today. Can you rush a split donation of $10 (or whatever you can spare) between Resist Reclaim Rebuild and me to become a Founding Donor to my campaign? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
CHIP IN TO STOP MAGA EXTREMISM!>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-annieandrews]
Thank you for believing in this campaign,
Dr. Annie Andrews

Peter,

I’m reaching out personally before the end of the quarter.

Across the country, candidates are entering some of the most important moments of their campaigns. They're spending long days talking to voters, attending community events, knocking on doors, and doing everything they can to get their message out there.

At In This Together PAC, we're working to make sure good, commonsense candidates can focus on that work — _not on whether they'll have the resources they need to get their message out before Election Day._

Because the truth is, who serves in our government – at every level – matters. It matters for families trying to afford healthcare. It matters for workers fighting for fair pay. It matters for parents who want a good education for their children and communities that deserve leaders who will show up, listen, and get things done.

The candidates we support are running for the right reasons: To serve the American people by leading with honesty and delivering results for our people. But they need our help to win these tough races.

| | | As June comes to a close and we wrap up Pride Month and Immigrant Heritage Month, we're reminded that progress happens because people fight for it. This [Pride Month](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134365921/631004739/-1778569518?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWI4YTYyYi1lODc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nZkJvxyMKTsVWZ6hpZUmPIVSYxTWXdtcWvBpAa1Jfus=&emci=a95554f2-bd74-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=51b8a62b-e874-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=560478) and year-round, California stands with the LGBTQ+ community across our state and the nation in celebrating love and acceptance. Some of the earliest LGBTQ+ resistance happened right here in our state, and California was on the [frontlines](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134365922/631004740/-1931329799?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWI4YTYyYi1lODc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nZkJvxyMKTsVWZ6hpZUmPIVSYxTWXdtcWvBpAa1Jfus=&emci=a95554f2-bd74-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=51b8a62b-e874-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=560478) of the battle for marriage equality and basic civil rights. We acknowledge and celebrate the LGBTQ+ community’s history of resistance, resilience, and the refusal to be erased, and will continue fighting for inclusion and the right for all to love and live freely.

In celebration of Pride Month, we invite you to check out two special conversations with CADEM Executive Director Melanie V. Ramil and two leaders in the LGBTQ+ community: [CADEM LGBTQ Caucus Chair Shay Franco-Clausen](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134365923/631004741/-1658944400?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWI4YTYyYi1lODc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nZkJvxyMKTsVWZ6hpZUmPIVSYxTWXdtcWvBpAa1Jfus=&emci=a95554f2-bd74-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=51b8a62b-e874-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=560478) and [Evan Minton, Champion for Justice, Climate Action & Equity](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134365924/631004742/-846137439?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWI4YTYyYi1lODc0LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nZkJvxyMKTsVWZ6hpZUmPIVSYxTWXdtcWvBpAa1Jfus=&emci=a95554f2-bd74-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&emdi=51b8a62b-e874-f111-ac9c-000d3a54bed0&ceid=560478). body:
We're on the verge of something big, help us get there

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/EuLiXTAA8ut?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| | | | | |

# _Field Report
_ The Quarter Ends & The Final Countdown Begins
---
|
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Help us reach our Q2 filing goal!](https://us.list-manage.com/BYGaTzYThjX?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
Friends,You received a message from the man himself earlier today. Now I, Michael - Adam’s Fundraising Director - have briefly stolen the digital reins to send you some important updates from the campaign trail. Because it just so happens to be a big day for campaign finance...
---
| |

# **Our quarterly filing will be submitted** _**tomorrow**_**! 💸**
---
| |
[ _****_](https://us.list-manage.com/WM3g_QEZ_bU?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
That will mark the end of Q2. In case you were unaware, campaigns have to file all their earnings and disbursements with the Federal Election Commission (FEC) and release a quarterly report. This is more than a legal obligation, it’s also important for optics. These FEC filings are viewed closely by Washington, the media, the other candidates, and even savvy voters, to evaluate how a candidate is doing in the runup to an election.
And it just so happens that the news is good for Adam Dunigan.
We have posted the _strongest quarter_ since the end of January. We’re set to cross the **$200K mark** in total contributions raised during the campaign. That’s a huge achievement! And if we play our cards right, we might even hit the quarter million mark before the August primary (or dare I speculate, cross $300K?).
For a first-time challenger candidate that doesn’t take corporate PAC or special interest money - that really says something.
It’s what we need to make Washington stand up and take notice. It’s what we need to motivate publicists and the mainstream media to get Adam press, and to instill additional trust in voters to ensure Adam brings this thing home in August.
As Adam always says - It shouldn’t be this way. Dollars shouldn’t dictate if candidates survive or thrive. Leaders should focus on governance and their constituents. But it makes no use to hate the game. So we must play it, and win it.
None of this would have been possible without YOU. Thank you for your support! 🙏Adam expresses his gratitude often. That’s because he feels it. It humbles all of us to see your trust. It’s our mission to make sure you never feel it was misplaced.
With that being said...I’m still three thousand short of my fundraising goal for this month. If you have been on the fence about donating, I don’t want to push, but quite literally...**now is the time**. We close the quarter TONIGHT.
Let’s show the nation something big.
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Let’s show the nation “We Mean Business!”](https://us.list-manage.com/WtnfsnRuBtd?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
# A4C Campaign Merch Launched! 🧢
---
| | Not sure how to donate? Why not buy some cool campaign merch?
[Did you know we have an entire storefront ](https://us.list-manage.com/X30iHH7zobp?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)of cool swag you can rock? Not only will you help promote our future Congressman Adam Dunigan, but your purchase goes back as a donation to the campaign (and you’ll look really cool). Here are some highlights you can pick up now!
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oYt7mOVuMvj?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/iIqKRmdTAKC?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Z36VaqM4tzx?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
| |
Don’t see anything you like? Why not _design your own_? 💡
That’s right, we take requests! Feel free to shoot us any cool ideas or polished designs by replying directly to this email. We’ll see if we can get them made up for you and offer them on the Adam for Congress storefront.
---
| |
# Field Launches! 🪧
---
| |
Besides creating cool merch, in case you were wondering what else a campaign does with donated funds (I can’t speak for other campaigns, but) WE are putting them to use - in the field!
Adam Dunigan’s **field operations officially kicked off** two weeks ago. Field is political campaign lingo for the most important part of a campaign - getting the candidate’s name out and getting in touch with voters so they vote. That means: knocking on doors, dropping literature, and putting up yard signs.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Volunteers of _all_ ages! ☺️
---
| | | And all species 🐶
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Help us print more yard signs and door hangers!](https://us.list-manage.com/Y6GbHSsR058?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| |
And what a team we have. Our original handful of crazy early believers has now grown into a truly amazing corps of over 100 people! Adam Dunigan for Congress represents all ages, walks of life, races, and sexual orientations. This week they will be facing 100o heat as they still continue to drop off literature and signage across Virginia’s 8th District. As well as showing up in a wave of support for Adam as he enters a charged debate season against the incumbent and other challengers.

---
| |
# Candidate Debates! 🗣️
---
| | See all those signs and volunteers above? And that’s only those who could make it out on a Sunday to...Adam’s first formal debate! Quite the army, isn’t it?
It’s the final 5 weeks leading up to Judgement Day. That means starting from last weekend until August 4th, Adam will be squaring off with Don Beyer (in the most gentlemanly of way of course, we throw no shade on our current Congressman) and 3 other challengers to talk policy, answer questions, and map out their paths forward for Virginia’s 8th and the United States.
And wouldn’t you know who completely stole the show last Sunday at the first candidate forum in Franconia? I bet you can guess...
[](https://us.list-manage.com/OFijk8chZ0d?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
If you want to see Adam in-action, there is an even bigger debate taking place _tomorrow_ in Arlington.
[](https://us.list-manage.com/17hCtS5G7zm?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
👉 [Register Now!](https://us.list-manage.com/Uzw4ApBFJVw?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
Come out and ask the hard questions.
---
| |
# New Campaign Video 🎬
---
| |
_And in case you missed Adam’s earlier message..._ If you want one more bit of validation into how your contributions are being used, look no further than Adam’s [amazing new campaign video](https://us.list-manage.com/jkmQffLBqsM?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0), produced by members of our ever-so-talented volunteer corps - The Back House Studio.
In closing, I’d be remiss to not mention that I moved to Arlington, VA all the way from Kansas City this January based on one reason -**to support Adam Dunigan**. That’s how much I believe in what he’s doing. I share that belief alongside 100+ other members of the team. And if anyone asks why - This video explains it better than I ever could.

[****](https://us.list-manage.com/4Pwd9wDRXq8?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
“Because a government works best when it remember who it serves.” “Public service isn’t power, it’s responsibility.”
[I know that I want to support someone who views service as not something he did, but****](https://us.list-manage.com/55eYNr2uVdi?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)who he****_**is**_**.** And I think you do too.
Let’s get out and win this thing.
---
| [DONATE $50 TODAY Let’s show the nation what public service means](https://us.list-manage.com/6zRPp0E3Z3t?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| | | | | |
Respectfully,**Michael and Team Adam for Congress**
Adam Dunigan - Congressional Candidate, Virginia's 8th District
[@adamduniganVA8](https://us.list-manage.com/nXAMzy3bjSB?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
[adam4congress.com](https://us.list-manage.com/D8WNHm19ie9?e=8c62ac7f38&c2id=fabe48e824e4f1229d0a62f6a8279ab0)
---
| | | | | [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/adam4congress/commemorating-juneteenth-and-the-vote-they-tried-to-delay-20277549?e=8c62ac7f38)
[update your preferences](https://adam4congress.us15.list-manage.com/profile?u=338019d71815bdab7363b2f42&id=b93cd38192&e=8c62ac7f38&c=7002b21503) or [unsubscribe](https://adam4congress.us15.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=338019d71815bdab7363b2f42&id=b93cd38192&t=b&e=8c62ac7f38&c=7002b21503)

subject: Less time than a TikTok

body:
I know you’re probably getting a lot of these emails right
now Peter, but I mean it when I
say this is really important.

I just need 60 seconds of your time. Less time than it takes to watch a
TikTok.

We're a few hours away from our end-of-quarter deadline, and we're still
working to close the gap on our $115,000 goal.

Here's why it matters. This cycle, we've already endorsed more than twice
the number of candidates we did in 2024. That’s twice the races to win.
Twice the doors that need knocking. Twice the campaigns that need real
resources behind them to level the playing field against their
deep-pocketed opponents.

And our blueprint is working. The momentum is undeniable. Our candidates
have racked up win after win, beating the establishment even against a
slew of corporate cash and special interest money. Every single one of
those wins happened because people like you stepped up to power our work.

We made a decision early on to go big this cycle because this moment
demands it. But going big only works if the support behind us matches our
ambition. We still have so much more to go. More endorsements on the way,
more wins to stack, and more candidates who are going to need us in their
corner when the Party machine and its corporate backers inevitably try to
outspend them.

So I’m asking one more time before our deadline hits. [ https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260630_3_final.qK87qS&refcode=em20260630-3666&amount=3&t=1001&akid=3666%2E587540%2EZ5_t75 ]Will you donate
$3 now?

Thanks for your support. We really couldn’t do this work without you.

— David

body:
A longer note on the state of campaign funding in our country – and why we are counting on your help to elect Democrats + turn things around.
#
Peter,
Across the country right now, there are incredible Democratic candidates running for office — up and down the entire ballot, in every single state.
They’ve got organizers knocking on doors. Volunteers making calls. These candidates are tirelessly showing up for their communities day after day.
The energy is there. The people are there.
**Money is the factor that is too often missing.**
**[ELECT DEMOCRATS: CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106011?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH)**
Here's the reality we’re facing right now: **The Republican Party is propped up by a network of billionaires and special interest groups who can write massive checks without giving it a second thought.** Dark money flows freely – funding attack ads, voter suppression efforts, and GOP candidates who answer to their donors instead of the people they were elected to serve.
**Democrats are doing things differently.** Our power comes from real people like you – grassroots donors who give what they can, when they can, because they believe that our country can do better than it’s doing right now.
And that matters enormously. But it also means we face hard choices.
**Right now, we’re working to support Democratic candidates in all 50 states.**
We all know there is no shortage of fights worth having – and no shortage of dedicated leaders who are ready to have them. But without adequate resources, we are forced to make impossible decisions about where to invest, which races to prioritize, and which communities we simply cannot reach.
**Every state matters. Every election matters. Every constituent matters.**
**[ELECT DEMOCRATS: CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106011?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH)**
We know what happens when Democrats show up everywhere: We win.
And we know what happens when we give up ground: Republicans entrench themselves for decades, gerrymander maps, restrict voting rights, and make it harder to fight back the next time. _We cannot afford to let that happen._
**If you've been waiting for the right moment to give – this is it.** Your donation today helps us support good candidates running in red and purple states across the country – where the odds are long but the stakes are even higher.
**[Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help us show up everywhere and WIN in 2026, Peter?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106011?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $5](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=4&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Contribute $15](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=5&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=6&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=7&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=8&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106012?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=9&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106011?refcode=em20260630-10641&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=10641%2E614464%2EgSaetH)

body:
There are only hours left before tonight's federal fundraising deadline.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
There are only **hours left** before tonight's federal fundraising deadline.By midnight, we'll close the books on this reporting period. The strength of our campaign will be measured not only by the number of supporters standing with us, but by whether we have the resources to keep reaching voters across Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
This campaign has been built from the ground up. We've knocked on doors, attended community events, listened to families, and brought together volunteers who believe our district deserves leadership that puts people ahead of politics.
Now we need your help to take the next step.
Our opponent has the advantages that come with incumbency and access to well-funded political networks. We have something even more powerful: a grassroots movement fueled by people who believe that government should work for working families—not just the well-connected.
That's why your contribution today matters.
Whether it's [**$5, $25, $50, or $100** , ](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=64dd6890dc&e=c6e7dff14c)every donation helps us:
* Reach more undecided voters.
* Expand our field and volunteer operations.
* Print campaign materials and voter guides.
* Strengthen our digital outreach.
* Build the campaign needed to compete and win.

We have the vision. We have the volunteers. We have the determination.Now we need the resources to match our momentum.
Please don't wait until tomorrow. Tomorrow is too late.
**Make your contribution before midnight tonight and help us finish this fundraising period with the strongest possible showing.**
Together, we can prove that a people-powered campaign can compete, can grow, and can win.
Thank you for believing in this campaign and for everything you do to move our community forward.
With appreciation,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Candidate for U.S. Congress, Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**P.S.** The deadline expires at **11:59 p.m. tonight**. Every contribution made before then counts toward this reporting period. If you've been planning to give, now is the time.

# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2461%2E5691347%2E18c6Lw)

Peter, it’s the last night of June and just hours from our end of month deadline.
I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024. And MAGA is lining up millions to flip this seat and drown out the truth with disinformation.
That’s the fight ahead. And I need you by my side.
Before you turn in: [**Can you rush $5 before midnight to help me win in Georgia?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.Bh0QdH&refcode=em260630-4-f&utm_campaign=em260630-4-f&t=2&akid=2461%2E5691347%2E18c6Lw)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.Bh0QdH&refcode=em260630-4-f&utm_campaign=em260630-4-f&t=3&akid=2461%2E5691347%2E18c6Lw)**
When I first ran for Senate six years ago, it was because I believed the election of someone so deeply unfit for the presidency posed a danger to the country.
Many people said it couldn’t be done. But you believed — not just in me, but in the idea that Georgia could lead, and that our Republic is worth defending.
Then we won. Not just a Senate seat, but the Senate majority for Democrats.
Now Trump has launched a power grab unprecedented in our history, abusing his power and trying to poison our Republic with fear and intimidation.
Americans are now living in fear of their own government.
I’m fighting back.
And I need you with me.
Please, if you can make it work, donate what you can before our June deadline.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.Bh0QdH&refcode=em260630-4-f&utm_campaign=em260630-4-f&t=4&akid=2461%2E5691347%2E18c6Lw)**
As always,
Jon Ossoff

This past weekend, my team and I were proud to be at Nashville Pride.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0ed3dee8-3798-4db3-be8d-4560b2ddef73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Not for a photo op. Not to check a box on a campaign schedule. but ecause every person at that festival deserves a representative who shows up for them.
**Let me be direct about where I stand.**
The LGBTQ+ community in Tennessee has been under sustained, deliberate attack by the same political machine that Scott DesJarlais has loyally served for 14 years. Anti-trans legislation targeting kids. Bills designed to strip rights from families. Laws that treat entire communities as problems to be solved rather than people to be represented.
**[I'm running for Congress on the principle that everyone deserves representation. If you agree with me, I'd be honored to have your help reach our monthly goal! We are only $300 away!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6887874d-4bf3-4607-bf4b-a6321f76227b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE HERE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6887874d-4bf3-4607-bf4b-a6321f76227b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe every person in Tennessee's 4th District deserves to live freely, love openly, and exist without fear of their own government. That includes the young people I met at Pride who told me they have never had a congressional candidate show up for them before.
**That changes now.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/361e457e-f09c-4eea-b06c-ef84857f2595?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

And to everyone reading this: we are closing out the month and every dollar right now directly fuels our ability to reach more communities, knock more doors, and build the kind of campaign that wins.
_**[Chip in $20 before midnight tonight. Let's finish this month strong and fight for everyone.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6887874d-4bf3-4607-bf4b-a6321f76227b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

**" Texas requests $10B in reimbursements from federal government for Operation Lone Star"** via [KVUE](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f2cb3-02ef-491f-a744-2156b4bc1f43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Jeff Bell** \--- Gov. **Greg Abbott** is officially applying to get reimbursed for what Texas spent on border security during the Biden administration.

The Texas governor said he submitted the paperwork to the federal government on Wednesday.

Abbott said under the Biden administration, Texas spent $10 billion of taxpayer money on Operation Lone Star that included sending Texas National Guard soldiers and state troopers to the border and building border barriers.

"In March 2021, I launched Operation Lone Star to fill in the dangerous gaps created by the Biden Administration's refusal to secure the border," Abbott said in a statement. **" Tensions with landowners rise as a raft of gas pipelines push through Texas properties"** via [The Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f82ee1-b0d0-45cb-a5f5-df98a20b6a7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Brandon Mulder** - In 2022, Ty and Leslie Eggemeyer received a notice in the mail that would shape the next four years of their lives. **" UT Austin researchers develop jacket that pulls drinking water from the air"** via [KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/deb1c42e-8866-4ca8-bf2b-fb8b84461b34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Eric Henrikson** -- University of Texas at Austin researchers have developed a jacket that pulls drinking water directly from the air, a technology they said could help hikers, farm workers and emergency responders stay hydrated in harsh conditions. "We designed these water harvesting jackets by engineering these very special textile fabrics," said Professor **Guihua Yu** with the Texas Materials Institute at UT Austin. The researchers published their work in the month's new issue of Science Advances.

According to the researchers, the specially engineered fabric can capture water from the atmosphere across a wide range of environments, from arid regions to humid climates like Central Texas. **" Texas Business Court Caseload Accelerates and Broadens After House Bill 40 Expands Jurisdiction"** via [The Texas Lawbook](https://substack.com/redirect/5b04b84b-1816-44e0-baa3-be19d7960785?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Marisa Secco Giles** , **Aaron Lira** & **Olivia Landry** -\- The Texas Business Court's second year is off to a faster start than its first, and the expansion of its jurisdictional reach through House Bill 40 appears to be contributing to the uptick in its caseload.

As discussed in prior coverage of House Bill 40, which became effective Sept. 1, 2025, the jurisdiction-expanding legislation lowered the value threshold to qualify as a "qualified transaction" from $10 million to $5 million; lowered the related amount-in-controversy threshold from $10 million to $5 million; provided jurisdiction over a broad range of intellectual property disputes; provided jurisdiction to enforce arbitration agreements and review arbitral awards in most cases where the underlying claim would otherwise fall within the Business Court's jurisdiction; and allowed pre-Sept. 1, 2024 cases to be transferred to the Business Court when there is agreement between the parties and the Business Court. House Bill 40 also allows the amount in controversy threshold in certain types of cases to be met by aggregating the total amount of all joined parties' claims.

From its inception Sept. 1, 2024, through the end of the first quarter of 2026, the Business Court received approximately 367 cases through either original filings or removals. Close to half of those cases were added after the effective date of House Bill 40. In the Eleventh (Houston) Division, the Business Court received nearly as many cases since House Bill 40 went into effect as it did during its entire first year. In the Third (Austin) Division, the Business Court received even more cases since House Bill 40 went into effect than it did during its first year of operation. _([The Texas Lawbook](https://substack.com/redirect/5b04b84b-1816-44e0-baa3-be19d7960785?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

Phase one includes "urgent" boundary realignment for select campuses with "projected growth that would otherwise require portables we cannot afford." It is unclear which schools will be impacted. The proposal for these changes will be announced next month, and the school board will vote on them in September.

Phase one also includes defining Marshall Middle School's attendance area for the first time. AISD will begin planning phase two in January 2027 and is expected to bring school closures. The school board will vote on these changes in fall 2027. "Taking this extra time allows us to monitor enrollment trends following recent closures, analyze data from our October enrollment snapshot, and further progress our academic visioning," AISD Superintendent **Matias Segura** wrote in the email. "We want to ensure that future engagement opportunities take place during the school year when it is most convenient for families to participate."

AISD cited concerns over the budget and enrollment efforts as some causes of the need for realigning boundaries. Under-enrolled schools financially strain the district. **Sean Mooney** , a real estate agent with Mooreland Properties, said affordability in the housing market has made it hard for young families with younger children to access some areas in Austin, leading to an aging population and underpopulated schools. _([KXAN Austin](https://substack.com/redirect/2528017b-8ddd-4a9e-a1bb-4a9ee3af165e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**#TXLEGE**
**" Texas leaders are asking data centers how much water they use. Most aren't responding"** via [Houston Public Media](https://substack.com/redirect/2e1ef1e5-f029-45a1-b0a2-f25ff906f5de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Alejandra Martinez** - Data centers use water to cool their massive arrays of computer servers. A state agency sent out a survey to figure out how much, but less than a third of the companies responded.

Data centers need a lot of water and energy. State officials want to know how much, and they hoped a survey sent to data center companies would give them the answers.

But at a legislative hearing Tuesday in Austin, they were told less than a third of the companies surveyed responded.
"Bad data, bad study," said state Rep. **Brad Buckley** , R-Salado, a member of the House Natural Resources Committee. _([Houston Public Media](https://substack.com/redirect/2e1ef1e5-f029-45a1-b0a2-f25ff906f5de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Texas Lawmakers Again Eye Regulation for Proxy Advisory Firms"** via [The Texan](https://substack.com/redirect/66e09796-7060-49db-a213-ab0101a2cd0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Holly Hansen** - State lawmakers are considering bolstering a state transparency law and imposing further regulations for proxy advisory firms, and may subpoena two foreign-owned advisors over ongoing concerns about conflicts of interest -- and claims the firms advised companies against relocating to Texas.

During the 89th Legislative Session, state lawmakers approved Senate Bill (SB) 2337 requiring proxy advisory firms to disclose when their recommendations are based on "non-financial factors" or "conflict with other proxy advisory services."

**Holly Hansen** is a Senior Reporter for The Texan where she has written extensively on criminal justice, public corruption, politics, and property rights, and is one of the state's most recognized journalists covering Houston and Harris County.

She is a frequent guest on radio and television shows, discussing local, state, and federal public affairs. She graduated from the University of Central Florida with a degree in History, has called Texas home for three decades, and now lives in the Austin area where she enjoys the outdoors and reading historic literature. _([THE TEXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/66e09796-7060-49db-a213-ab0101a2cd0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**BUSINESS NEWS**
**" Tesla's tiny robotaxi fleet could 'dramatically scale,' Texas official says"** via [Austin American-Statesman](https://substack.com/redirect/fe5d30a8-8d7a-4d52-8a5a-f498ca5db71e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Andrea Guzm an** - Tesla Inc. officially began operating a robotaxi service in Austin a year ago. Now, leadership at the Texas Department of Transportation thinks its fleet could start to surge.

TxDOT Executive Director**Marc Williams** experienced a production version of the Cybercab at the Texas Innovation Invitational and wrote on LinkedIn afterward that the purpose-built robotaxi will "dramatically scale" Tesla's cab operations over the coming months.

"Observing this vehicle firsthand -- from its design and butterfly doors to the cargo trunk configuration -- provides a tangible example of how quickly our transportation system is evolving," Williams wrote. "Sitting inside the cabin, the complete absence of traditional driver controls underscores a significant shift in mobility and vehicle design. No steering wheel, no accelerator, no brake. Only a single touch-screen monitor." _([AAS](https://substack.com/redirect/fe5d30a8-8d7a-4d52-8a5a-f498ca5db71e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" NRG Energy opens first power plant in 10 years to meet energy demand"** via [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/c7d06b24-bea0-412d-8f82-9f0eaf472990?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s**Naina Srivastava** - NRG Energy opened its first power plant in over a decade late last month, partly funded by the state's energy fund.

The power plant, located off the Sam Houston Highway in Willowbrook, is a peaker plant -- a power plant that operates one to two hours each day, acting as a shock absorber to the power grid -- said **Matt Pistner** , the president of NRG Wholesale. As energy demand in Texas continues to surge, largely driven by new AI data centers, developers have looked toward Houston, the energy capital of the world, as a location for new sites.

The TH Wharton generating station is one of three NRG power plants funded by the Texas Energy Fund, a state initiative established in 2023 that is managed by the Texas Public Utility Commission. Two others are expected online by 2028, both also in the Houston area.

The TH Wharton plant is also one of 108 new gas power plants pitched between the beginning of 2024 and April 2025, according to a report by the Environmental Integrity Project. Approximately half of the projects listed were clustered in the Houston area, making Houston a hub for new power plant developments. _([HOU CHRON](https://substack.com/redirect/c7d06b24-bea0-412d-8f82-9f0eaf472990?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

Neugebauer** , shareholder and co-founder of Fermi Inc., along with affiliated participants, filed definitive Schedule 14A proxy materials seeking agent designations to call a Special Meeting and urge shareholders to support their slate. The filing states the Texas Business Court granted Mr. Neugebauer's emergency motion for expedited discovery related to the Board's adoption of a 70% supermajority bylaw to expand the board.

The participants say the court order requires Fermi to produce documents and testimony about the bylaw, federal-court actions, and the cancelled Special Meeting. The proxy materials state Mr. Neugebauer beneficially owns 146,516,035 shares of common stock, composed of 44,656,376 shares held by Vicksburg Investments Management LLC, 94,359,659 shares held by the **Melissa A. Neugebauer** 2020 Trust, and 7,500,000 shares underlying RSUs that vested.

The court's order for expedited discovery, dated June 26, 2026, is described as requiring the company to produce documents and testimony about its adoption of a 70% supermajority bylaw and earlier litigation positions. The proxy states these materials are relevant to a Special Meeting effort led by the Fermi Founder Parties.

The filing frames the development as material to shareholder rights and solicits agent designations to call a Special Meeting. Subsequent filings and produced discovery will determine whether the bylaw and related actions were procedurally justified; timing and scope of discovery are described but specific documents and deposition subjects are not listed in the excerpt. _([Stock Titan](https://substack.com/redirect/4b028279-ffde-42c3-8f75-63796f677476?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" H-E-B to build $175M refrigerated facility on the East Side"** via [San Antonio Express-News](https://substack.com/redirect/116e6c1a-ef54-4acb-857b-1bac5b1fe665?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Lily O 'Neill **- H-E-B wants to expand its manufacturing and distribution facilities on San Antonio's East Side. H-E-B plans to build a $175 million refrigerated facility at its East Side campus.

The new property is part of the San Antonio-based grocer's largest-ever investment in its manufacturing and supply chain operations. H-E-B plans to construct a two-story, 675,000-square-foot facility with refrigeration space, as well as office and administration space, at 2045 South Foster Road, according to a filing with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation. Construction is expected to begin in August this year and be completed by March 2028.

The grocer declined a request for comment on the new facility.

The company also is working on building a $125 million bakery production facility at the campus, and said in a news release that it plans to add a transportation building and additional facilities. _([San Antonio Express-News](https://substack.com/redirect/116e6c1a-ef54-4acb-857b-1bac5b1fe665?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Vistra gets funding to expand Ward County power plant"** via [Midland Reporter-Telegram](https://substack.com/redirect/2f1b1245-d1a6-4a41-9826-a97b73b98d2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Mella McEwen** - Plans to add two new natural gas units to a Ward County power plant have received approval for the eighth Texas Energy Fund loan from the Public Utility Commission of Texas under its In-ERCOT Generation Loan Program.

**Vistra Corp.** plans to add 860 megawatts of new reliable power by building the two new natural gas units at its Permian Basin Power Plant, which would more than triple the site's current capacity. The additional 860 megawatts would be enough electricity to power about 215,000 Texas homes. The project is expected to begin generating power for the Electric Reliability Council of Texas power region in 2028.

Vistra announced in September that it planned to move forward with the next phase of its capital plan to support grid reliability in Texas.

In 2024, the company identified more than $1 billion worth of potential capital additions in generation capacity within the Texas power market operated by ERCOT by 2028 if market conditions were supportive. Citing customer demand and West Texas' growing power needs, particularly the state's expanding oil and natural gas industries, the company made a final investment decision to build the two new natural gas units. _([MRT](https://substack.com/redirect/2f1b1245-d1a6-4a41-9826-a97b73b98d2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_

**" Casey's eyes Texas expansion by building on small-town legacy"** via [The Des Moines Register](https://substack.com/redirect/77503913-39c4-469f-ad17-a6c7d1cc23fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - Casey's is looking to Texas as a prime location to expand its small-town business model, which has thrived in Iowa and across the Midwest, CEO**Darren Rebelez** says.

"We love Texas," Rebelez said Wednesday, June 24, at Casey's investor day in New York City, where the company detailed its strategic plan for the next three years.

Iowa small towns, where Casey's stores are a common fixture, launched the nearly 60-year-old convenience store chain that is now the nation's third largest.

"When I think of growth prospects, this is the anecdote I like to give: In Iowa, our home state, we have 550 stores with a population of 3 million people," Rebelez said. "The population of Texas is 30 million people. So, are we going to put 5,500 stores in Texas? Probably not. But could you squint and see 1,000 stores, 2,000 stores? I don't see why not." _([The Des Moines Register](https://substack.com/redirect/77503913-39c4-469f-ad17-a6c7d1cc23fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_
